constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_type = 'OPERATING_EXPENSE'::text) AND (event_type = 'EXPENSE_RECOGNIZED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'EXPENSE_PAYMENT'::text) AND (event_type = 'EXPENSE_PAYMENT'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'DAILY_SALES_CUT'::text) AND (event_type = 'SALE_RECOGNIZED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'SALES_REFUND'::text) AND (event_type = 'SALE_REFUNDED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'GATEWAY_SETTLEMENT'::text) AND (event_type = 'SETTLEMENT_RECOGNIZED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'RECEIVING_REPORT'::text) AND (event_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIVED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'PURCHASE_INVOICE'::text) AND (event_type = 'PURCHASE_INVOICED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'PURCHASE_CREDIT'::text) AND (event_type = 'PURCHASE_CREDITED'::text)) OR ((source_type = 'INVOICE_PAYMENT'::text) AND (event_type = 'INVOICE_PAID'::text))))
FOREIGN KEY (company_id, account_id) REFERENCES accounting_accounts(company_id, id)

postVerification.scope: Existencia de columnas/índices de todas las tablas; RLS/políticas/triggers de inventario del lote autorizado. No certifica comportamiento runtime ni piloto.

inventoryPolicies.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (branches b
     JOIN inventory_items i ON ((i.id = inventory_batches.item_id)))
  WHERE ((b.id = inventory_batches.branch_id) AND (b.company_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_company_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) AND (i.company_id = b.company_id)))) AND ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_branch_id'::text, true), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (branch_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_branch_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid)))
